tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.empty: No tenants yet. Click "Add tenant" to provision the first one.
tenants.deleteDefault: The default tenant cannot be deleted
tenants.suspendMessage: This blocks all logins for "{{name}}" until reactivated.

add.title: Add tenant
add.name: Name *
add.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only — this becomes the tenant's future subdomain and can't be changed later.
add.slugInvalid: Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens are allowed.
add.emailHint: Optional. One shop per email address.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.warning: This permanently removes the shop and everything it owns — sales, clients, debts, drawers, users and settings. Its subdomain is removed too. There is no undo and no backup taken.
delete.suspendInstead: If you only want to stop them logging in, close this and use Suspend instead — that keeps the data.

impersonation.viewingAs: You are viewing as {{who}} — {{tenant}}. Any changes are recorded.

plan.title: Plan — {{name}}
plan.modulesHint: The customer still chooses what to switch on — this is the ceiling, not the setting. Dashboard, Settings, Audit and Closing are always included and cannot be sold separately.
plan.paymentHint: Sets the plan back to active and runs it until this date. Leave it empty for no expiry. Grace resets, so a later lapse gets a full window.
plan.keyHint: Only needed for a customer running the desktop app. Without a key their install is unrestricted — issuing one is what lets this plan reach it.
plan.issueNew: Issue a new key (revokes the old one)
plan.copyNow: Copy this now — it is shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
plan.trialLeft: Free trial: {{n}} day(s) left, last day {{day}}.
plan.activateHint: Ends the free trial: the shop pays from now on and can add records again. Separate from Suspend, which only stops sign-in.
plan.extendHint: The trial runs to the end of this day (Beirut time). An ended trial starts again.
plan.featuresHint: Extra features for this shop only. Off for every shop until you switch them on here.
plan.feature_kpi_snapshots_hint: Saves the shop's month-end balances (debts both ways, stock value, line credits) and shows them to its admins.

invite.title: Send invite
invite.intro: We'll email a sign-up link that works once and expires in 72 hours. The shop will use this email as its contact address.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.emailNotConfigured: Email not configured — invites cannot be sent from this server. Use "Add tenant" to create shops until it is set up.
invitations.revokeMessage: The link sent to {{email}} will stop working. You can send a new invite later.
